expect.description: Ten rainless days of building July heat, broken on the last day by 38 mm. The scenario ends on the wet day on purpose: the balance reports the state of its newest day, so a scenario that ran on past the rain would report 'ok' and the satisfied state — the one thing this scenario exists to show — would never reach a screen. Outdoor specimens under open sky show 'satisfied by rain' rather than having their task vanish. Covered and indoor ones do not, and a plant that was never due is 'ok' and not 'satisfied'.

assertions.note: 45 L lemon on the uncovered Back Terrace; due from day 4
8 L basil on the same terrace; a small pot is due by day 1
in-ground rose in the South Border: a 60 mm profile at K_c 0.85 needs eight days of this heat to cross, which is why the dry spell is ten and not six
in-ground hostas in the uncovered North Shade Bed
Covered Porch: f_cover = 0, so the rain never reaches it and the watering stays owed
also on the Covered Porch, and also still owed

the drought-adapted lavender hedge never crossed its threshold in ten days, so the rain settled nothing. 'ok' is not 'satisfied': a watering that was never owed must not be reported as one the sky did for you
indoor, interval rule, unaffected by weather

assertions.satisfied_task_stays_visible: a satisfied watering keeps its place in the round, its plant and its amount. A task that vanished because it rained is indistinguishable from one that was never scheduled

assertions.calendar_behaviour: satisfied tasks are cancelled in the ICS feed by their existing UID, not dropped and not duplicated
